inspection.scope: All 15 newly acquired original main graphics, all 11 pages of a local LibreOffice derivative of original Dong SI DOCX, native document text and embedded EMF table text; current cached publisher excerpts only for main prose.

dong_figures.1: DIW/F0–F8 photographs; XRD traces F0–F12 and bulk, H/Q/F/C labels. Do not assign omitted phase-label definitions without caption.
dong_figures.2: Size-fraction axes F0–F8, particle size nm, lithium content percent and zeta potential mV; colloidal-clay and gel annotations. Graph alone does not establish total Li mass fraction without fraction masses.
dong_figures.3: Dissolved-ion percentages against pH for Ca, Li/Mg/Mn/Fe and Si/Al/F. No raw point values digitized; percent denominator and assay design still require main methods.
dong_figures.4: Separate Expt Li(F0) circles and Expt Li(bulk clay) triangles versus PHREEQC total-Li/free-Li/LiSO4/LiF curves, concentration axis M. SI-2 gives original numerical rows and different equilibration durations; neither is product yield.
dong_figures.5: 0.2 M H2SO4 and 0.2 M H3PO4 dissolved-cation percentages versus days. Symbols and smooth curves kept distinct; fit equation/replicate definitions not acquired.
dong_figures.6: HCl concentration series 2.0/0.2/0.02 M and five-acid comparison at0.2 M, Li dissolved percent versus days; no measured endpoint digitization or fitted-parameter acceptance.
dong_figures.7: Author structural reaction schematic with exchange, F-brucite-like sheet and silicate dissolution stages. Mechanistic proposal, not separately observed isolated phase or recovered product.

vanrompaey_figures.1: Untreated hectorite and acid-treated diffraction; H/C/D labels, 0.25 M nitric/hydrochloric/sulphuric and0.125 M sulphuric labels; full caption/phase definitions missing.
vanrompaey_figures.2: 0.25 M H2SO4 diffraction at2/4/6/8h; Mg++/K+/K+350/K+520 treatments visible.
vanrompaey_figures.3: 0.25 M HCl diffraction at2/4/6/8h; preserved orientation/treatment distinctions.
vanrompaey_figures.4: 0.25 M HNO3 diffraction at2/4/6/8h; absence of basal reflection not assumed complete mineral dissolution.
vanrompaey_figures.5: Nitric-acid Al and Si solution mg/L bar charts,25minutes/1/2/4/6/8h and0.25/0.5/1M. High-acid Si decreases late; no exact bar heights transcribed.
vanrompaey_figures.6: Sulphuric-acid Si and Li solution mg/L,0.125/0.25/0.5/1M. Si and Li concentration trends are distinct; no source-specific precipitation yield inferred.
vanrompaey_figures.7: Hydrochloric-acid Si and Mg solution mg/L at0.25/0.5/1M; high-acid Mg plateau/lower concentration preserved as visual observation.
vanrompaey_figures.8: PanelA0.25 M acid comparison uses dissolved Li fraction; panelB1 N uses dissolved Mg fraction. Both use minutes and50% reference line. These are different analytes and concentration bases, not a single Li curve.

supplement.pages1to5: Cover/title/six authors, SI1–SI5 and two embedded image tables all viewed; 142 numeric body cells manually keyed and compared to native EMF strings.
supplement.pages6to11: Complete native PHREEQC example read and all rendered pages viewed; no execution, database selection or kinetic refit performed.
supplement.SI1: Stokes cutoffs differ from analyzed sizes; F0 nominal<20nm and F8 nominal2–63um settled. No size definition silently substituted.
supplement.SI2: AFM caption predominantly1.2nm layers; image height distribution and scaling not independently fitted.
supplement.SI3: XRD comparison explicitly labels Hectorite-16A PDF00-009-0031 and Fluohectorite PDF01-082-4374; reference patterns are not an issuing mineral-authority identifier.
supplement.SI4: Isopropyl-alcohol color change versus Milli-Q reference; no quantitative organic assay inferred.
supplement.SI5: Residue with coexisting organic matter at pH~2.3, initial/~3weeks/3months; this does not establish microbial causality or disappearance of the solid framework.
supplement.tableSI1: 0.062g/L caption; ICP-MS elemental composition with F by ion chromatography; duplicate ppb, mean ppb/uM, molar ratios and normalized coefficients. FinalFe0.108 versus current cached abstract0.107 retained.
supplement.tableSI2: F0 6.2g/L,7pH rows6.7–1.55, H2SO4-adjusted/~15days; bulk5loadings333.3–100g/L/~12h in10%H2SO4. Percent basis and full assay methods unknown.
